body:

[a] https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/buildlogs/el9_amd64_gcc14/CMSSW_20_1_UBSAN_X_2026-10-14-2300/Fireworks/Core

title: fireworks: Explicitly link against rootgeomchecker to avoid UBSAN link error
